transcript:
inc-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate via gateway-prod (~5.2% over baseline). Paging oncall.

oncall-alice: seeing it too. Graphs: 5xx spike at 12:02 UTC, latency climbing. Investigating.

ops-jordan: quick check — health of downstream model-pool looks okay from metrics, but gateway error logs show `upstream reset` + `context canceled` around same time.

oncall-alice: pulling logs now. `gcloud logging read "resource.type=gae_app AND severity>=ERROR AND textPayload:upstream" --limit 200` shows many `stream closed` and `502` from upstream-connector.

prod-eng-sam: any deploys at ~12:00? CI shows a config push to gateway (keepalive tweak) at 11:59 by infra-automation.

sre-kim: tagging infra-automation here — @infra-automation can you confirm the change? Might be connection pool mismatch.

infra-automation (bot): rollback failed config:infra/gateway/keepalive=60s -> 30s at 12:01 due to validation error on canary. Change was partially applied to 3/5 gateway nodes.

oncall-alice: that explains partial behavior. I'm going to scale traffic away from the 3 affected nodes. Applying patch to route table.

oncall-alice: command:
```
ku apply -f overlays/gateway/remove-nodes.yaml --context=prod
# or
redwoodctl route shift --exclude-node=node-12,node-15,node-18
```

ops-jordan: doing a quick restart of gateway-proxy on those nodes to reset connection state while we move traffic.

oncall-bob: I'm taking over page (handing off). oncall-alice — can you summarize current state for me?

oncall-alice: handing off: 3 nodes had partial keepalive config, causing upstream connector to drop long-lived connections -> elevated 5xx and timeouts. Traffic shifted to healthy nodes, restarting gateways on affected nodes. CDN/edge already healthy. No model pool restarts. CS: some live customers reported errors intermittently.

oncall-bob: acknowledged. I'll keep the page. Rolling revert of the config to previous stable value and redeploying to all nodes now.

prod-eng-sam: created hotfix PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/gateway/+/PR-4821 — revert keepalive change and add guard so partial deploys fail fast. Kicking CI.

sre-kim: quick mitigation metrics: 5xx back down to 0.8% within 4 minutes of traffic shift. Latency returning to baseline. Marking incident as mitigated but keeping page open for verification.

customer-success-lee: we have two customers reporting elevated failures (acct: acme-inc, acct: blueco). Both on premium plans — reaching out with a status note now. No major production outage but request for postmortem.

oncall-bob: noted. I'll prepare initial timeline and postmortem stub. Action items immediate:
1) Finish hotfix PR and deploy global revert (prod-eng-sam) — target: +25m
2) Update gateway deploy runbook with check for partial config application and explicit node count validation (sre-kim) — target: +48h
3) Tune the 5xx alert threshold and add an alert for partial deploy diff between nodes (ops-jordan) — target: +24h
4) Contact CS to send templated incident message to affected customers (customer-success-lee) — now

prod-eng-sam: hotfix CI passed, deploying canary (#1 node) now, will watch for any regressions. Canary logs are green.

oncall-bob: canary looks good. Promoting to full deploy. Rolling update in progress.

oncall-bob: full revert deployed. Post-deploy: 5xx at 0.4% and latency normal. Closing page provider alert but leaving incident channel open for follow-ups.

sre-kim: reopening runbook note: add a pre-check step that verifies config applied uniformly to >80% of nodes before traffic routing changes. Also add a small playbook section for immediate traffic-shift commands.

ops-jordan: I'll create the alert tuning ticket: #INF-2397 (add partial-deploy-alert + adjust 5xx baseline). Linking to this thread.

customer-success-lee: sent the status update to affected customers, included timeline and ETA for full postmortem. They acknowledged, asked for root cause and compensatory credits — will sync with billing.

oncall-bob: final summary: root cause = partial config change (keepalive) applied to subset of gateway nodes -> upstream connection resets -> elevated 5xx/timeouts. Mitigation = shift traffic away + restart affected gateway nodes + revert config. Impact = intermittent errors for some customers for ~12 minutes peak. Next steps = hotfix merged/deployed, runbook updates, alert tuning, customer comms. Owners assigned above.

sre-kim: assigning follow-up tasks in the tracker:
- INF-2397 alert tuning (ops-jordan)
- INF-2398 runbook update (sre-kim)
- INF-2399 deploy guard improvement (prod-eng-sam)

oncall-bob: thank you all. I'll mark incident as resolved in the incident system after we confirm CS/finance follow-up. Closing thread in 1h if no new regressions.

inc-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — mitigated at 12:18 UTC. Postmortem required: set severity=sev3. Incident channel will remain open for follow-ups.
